subject: afrikaans-fal
description: Afrikaans First Additional Language consolidated question bank. CAPS Foundation Phase (Grades 1-3) + Intermediate Phase (Grades 4-6, in build). TUTORING-FIRST model: every skill targets 20+ items; a learner works through the whole set; a wrong answer triggers Ruby reteaching (show memo) and re-queues that item later. Per-skill fields: gate (NONE), complete_when, reteach_on_error, target_item_count, caps_term, sensitive, templates, recovery_strategy, questions[]. SCHEMA per question: ref, question (English instruction), ruby_prompt (English voiceover), audio (Afrikaans for listening items), context (Afrikaans passage / poster text for reading items), image_refs (optional manifest keys for image-match), input_type, options, expected, memo, error_signals, difficulty (1-3). FAL pedagogy: instructions/hints in English (home language), target content in Afrikaans.

AF.G1.KLK.01.title: Herken rymwoorde (identify rhyming words)
AF.G1.KLK.01.description: Hear Afrikaans words and identify which rhyme.
AF.G1.KLK.01.recovery_strategy: Stretch and exaggerate the ending sound. Compare just two words before offering three choices.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'kat'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word ends with the same sound as 'kat'?
questions.audio: kat ... mat ... hond
questions.memo: 'kat' and 'mat' both end in the -at sound, so they rhyme. 'hond' and 'boom' end in different sounds.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'huis'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word sounds the same at the end as 'huis'?
questions.audio: huis ... muis ... boom
questions.memo: 'huis' and 'muis' both end in -uis. They rhyme.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'boom'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen for the ending sound. Which word rhymes with 'boom'?
questions.audio: boom ... room ... vis
questions.memo: 'boom' and 'room' both end in -oom, so they rhyme.

questions.question: Do 'son' and 'bal' rhyme?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Do these two words rhyme: 'son' and 'bal'?
questions.audio: son ... bal
questions.memo: 'son' ends in -on and 'bal' ends in -al. The endings are different, so they do not rhyme.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'hond'?

AF.G1.TAA.02.title: Ontkenning (negation)
AF.G1.TAA.02.description: Understand the Afrikaans double-negative pattern (sentence wrapped with two 'nie').
AF.G1.TAA.02.recovery_strategy: Contrast a positive sentence with its negative. Highlight the two 'nie' words that wrap the idea.

questions.question: What does 'Sy lees nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy lees nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'nie' makes it negative: 'Sy lees nie' = 'She does not read'.

questions.question: Does 'Ek hou nie van pere nie' mean the person LIKES pears?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Ek hou nie van pere nie'. Does this person like pears?
options: No, they do not like pears
questions.expected: No, they do not like pears
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words wrap the sentence to make it negative: 'I do NOT like pears.'

questions.question: How do you say 'Do not run' in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one tells someone NOT to run?
questions.memo: 'Moenie ... nie' means 'Do not ...': 'Moenie hardloop nie' = 'Do not run'.

questions.question: Make it negative: 'Hy speel' → 'He does NOT play'.
questions.ruby_prompt: Which sentence means 'He does not play'?
questions.memo: Add 'nie' at the end: 'Hy speel nie' = 'He does not play'.

questions.question: What does 'Sy kan nie spring nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy kan nie spring nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words make it negative: 'She cannot jump.'

questions.question: What does 'Hy eet nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hy eet nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'nie' makes it negative: 'Hy eet nie' = 'He does not eat'.

questions.question: Make it negative: 'Sy sing' → 'She does NOT sing'.
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'She does not sing'?
questions.memo: Add 'nie' at the end: 'Sy sing nie' = 'She does not sing'.

questions.question: Does 'Ek het nie 'n hond nie' mean the person HAS a dog?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ek het nie 'n hond nie'. Do they have a dog?
options: No, they do not have a dog
questions.expected: No, they do not have a dog
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words wrap the sentence: 'I do NOT have a dog.'

questions.question: How do you say 'Do not touch' in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'Do not touch'?
questions.memo: 'Moenie ... nie' means 'Do not ...': 'Moenie raak nie' = 'Do not touch'.

questions.question: What does 'Hulle speel nie buite nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hulle speel nie buite nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words make it negative: 'They do not play outside.'

questions.question: Does 'Sy is nie moeg nie' mean she IS tired?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy is nie moeg nie'. Is she tired?
questions.memo: 'nie ... nie' makes it negative: 'She is NOT tired.'

questions.question: Which word makes an Afrikaans sentence negative?
questions.memo: 'nie' means 'not' — it makes a sentence negative.

questions.question: What does 'Ek wil nie slaap nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ek wil nie slaap nie'. What does it mean?
options: I do not want to sleep
questions.expected: I do not want to sleep
questions.memo: 'nie ... nie' wraps it: 'I do NOT want to sleep.'

questions.question: How do you say 'Do not run' in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'Do not run'?
questions.memo: A command 'Do not ...' uses 'Moenie ... nie': 'Moenie hardloop nie'.

questions.question: Does 'Hy kan nie swem nie' mean he CAN swim?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hy kan nie swem nie'. Can he swim?
questions.memo: 'nie ... nie' makes it negative: 'He CANNOT swim.'

questions.question: Make it negative: 'Ons werk' → 'We do NOT work'.
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'We do not work'?
questions.memo: Add 'nie' at the end: 'Ons werk nie' = 'We do not work'.

questions.question: What does 'Die baba huil nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Die baba huil nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'nie' makes it negative: 'The baby does not cry.'

questions.question: How many 'nie' words wrap a long negative like 'Ek hou nie van koffie nie'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Count the 'nie' words in 'Ek hou nie van koffie nie'.
questions.memo: Afrikaans wraps a negative idea with two 'nie' words: one after the verb and one at the end.

questions.question: What does 'Moenie praat nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Moenie praat nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'Moenie ... nie' = 'Do not ...': 'Moenie praat nie' = 'Do not talk'.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative for 'She does not read.'
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'She does not read'?
questions.memo: Put 'nie' after the verb (here at the end): 'Sy lees nie' = 'She does not read'.

AF.G1.TAA.03.title: Vraagsinne (question words)

questions.memo: 'Wie?' means 'Who?' — it asks about a person.

questions.question: What does 'Hoe?' mean?

questions.question: Which question word means 'Who?'

questions.question: Which question fits the answer 'By die skool' (At the school)?

questions.memo: 'Waar?' (Where?) fits a place answer like 'at the school'.

questions.question: What does 'Hoekom?' mean?
questions.memo: 'Hoekom?' means 'Why?' — it asks for a reason.

questions.question: Which question word asks 'How many?'
Which question fits the answer 'Drie' (Three)?

questions.question: What does 'Wat?' mean?

questions.memo: 'Jy' means 'you': 'Jy is my maat' (You are my friend).

questions.question: Which word means 'I'?
Which word means 'you' for MORE than one person?

questions.memo: 'julle' means 'you' (more than one). 'jy' is just one person.

questions.question: What does 'Ons speel' mean?

questions.question: What is the plural of 'pen'?

questions.question: What does 'Die meisie loop' mean?

options: The boy rides a bike fast

questions.question: Which picture matches 'Die seun ry fiets'?

questions.question: What does 'Die voël vlieg in die lug' mean?

The bird sits in a tree

AF.G2.LEE.05.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae en som op (comprehension & simple summary)
AF.G2.LEE.05.description: Answer comprehension questions and pick the best one-sentence summary.
AF.G2.LEE.05.recovery_strategy: Re-read, then ask 'what is the whole thing mostly about?' before offering summary choices.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die hond hardloop. Die hond spring. Die hond speel in die tuin.'
options: A dog playing in the garden
questions.expected: A dog playing in the garden
questions.memo: Every sentence is about the dog playing in the garden (tuin).

questions.question: Read: 'Sara is siek. Sy bly in die bed.' Why does Sara stay in bed?
questions.context: Text: 'Sara is siek. Sy bly in die bed.'
questions.memo: 'Sara is siek' = Sara is sick, so she stays in bed.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Ons eet ontbyt. Ons eet middagete. Ons eet aandete.'
options: The meals we eat in a day
questions.expected: The meals we eat in a day
questions.memo: ontbyt (breakfast), middagete (lunch), aandete (supper) — the meals of the day.

questions.question: Read: 'Die reën val. Die kinders bly binne.' Why do the children stay inside?
questions.context: Text: 'Die reën val. Die kinders bly binne.'
questions.memo: 'Die reën val' = it is raining, so the children stay inside (binne).

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die voël maak 'n nes. Sy lê eiers. Die kuikens kom uit.'
questions.memo: The bird makes a nest, lays eggs, and the chicks (kuikens) hatch — about a bird and her babies.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die kat klim in die boom. Sy kry 'n voël. Sy klim weer af.'
questions.memo: Every sentence is about the cat in the tree.

questions.question: Read: 'Tom hou van sokker. Hy speel elke dag.' What does Tom like?
questions.context: Text: 'Tom hou van sokker. Hy speel elke dag. Hy wil 'n ster word.'
questions.memo: 'Tom hou van sokker' = Tom likes soccer.

questions.question: Read the text. What is the weather like?
questions.context: Text: 'Die reën val hard. Die wind waai. Die weer is sleg.'
questions.memo: Rain + wind + 'die weer is sleg' (the weather is bad).

questions.question: Read: 'Ma koop melk, brood en eiers.' What did Mom buy?
questions.context: Text: 'Ma koop melk, brood en eiers by die winkel.'
questions.memo: The text lists 'melk, brood en eiers'.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die seun plant blomme. Hy gee water. Die tuin is mooi.'
questions.memo: Planting flowers + watering + 'die tuin' (the garden) = making a garden.

questions.question: Read: 'Lisa is jarig. Almal sing vir haar.' Why do they sing?
questions.context: Text: 'Lisa is jarig. Sy kry geskenke. Almal sing vir haar.'
questions.memo: 'jarig' = having a birthday. They sing because it's her birthday.

questions.question: Read: 'Die hond is honger. Hy kry 'n been.' What did the dog find?
questions.context: Text: 'Die hond is honger. Hy soek kos. Hy kry 'n been.'
questions.memo: 'Hy kry 'n been' = he gets/finds a bone.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Ons gaan see toe. Ons swem en bou sandkastele. Dit is lekker.'
questions.memo: Going to the sea + swimming + sandcastles = a day at the beach.

questions.question: Read: 'Die voël is moeg. Sy vlieg na haar nes.' Where does the bird go?
questions.context: Text: 'Die voël is moeg. Sy vlieg na haar nes. Sy gaan slaap.'

questions.question: Read: 'Die kar was stukkend. Nou werk dit weer.' What was wrong with the car?
questions.context: Text: 'Pappa maak die kar reg. Dit was stukkend. Nou werk dit weer.'

questions.question: Read: 'Die klas ry met die bus. Hulle besoek die dieretuin.' Where do they go?
questions.context: Text: 'Die klas gaan op 'n uitstappie. Hulle ry met die bus. Hulle besoek die dieretuin.'

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Sara help haar ma. Sy was die skottelgoed. Sy vee die vloer.'
questions.memo: Washing dishes + sweeping the floor = helping at home.

questions.question: Read: 'Die seun lees oor ruimteskepe. Hy droom om 'n ruimtevaarder te word.' What does he want to be?
questions.context: Text: 'Die seun lees 'n boek oor ruimteskepe. Hy droom om 'n ruimtevaarder te word.'
questions.memo: 'ruimtevaarder' = astronaut. He dreams of becoming one.

questions.question: Read: 'Dit is winter. Dit is baie koud.' Why do they wear warm clothes?
questions.context: Text: 'Dit is winter. Dit is baie koud. Ons trek warm klere aan.'
questions.memo: Winter + 'baie koud' (very cold) = they wear warm clothes.

questions.question: Read: 'Die muis sien die kaas. Die kat sien die muis.' What might happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then predict what comes next.
questions.context: Text: 'Die muis sien die kaas. Hy hardloop vinnig. Die kat sien die muis.'
questions.memo: The cat sees the mouse, so next it will likely chase it. Good readers predict what comes next.

AF.G2.LUI.01.title: Volg opeenvolgende instruksies (follow consecutive instructions)
AF.G2.LUI.01.description: Respond to two short consecutive Afrikaans instructions.
AF.G2.LUI.01.recovery_strategy: Replay and break into one step at a time. Confirm the first step before the second.

questions.question: What two things were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both steps, then choose.
questions.audio: Trek 'n sirkel. Kleur dit rooi in.
options: Draw a circle, then colour it red
Draw a square, then colour it blue
Colour a circle, then draw a line
questions.expected: Draw a circle, then colour it red
questions.memo: 'Trek 'n sirkel' = draw a circle; 'Kleur dit rooi in' = colour it red.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Vat die boek. Sit dit op die tafel.
options: Take the book, put it on the table
Take the pen, put it in the bag
Open the book on the table
questions.expected: Take the book, put it on the table
questions.memo: 'Vat die boek' = take the book; 'Sit dit op die tafel' = put it on the table.

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what to do first.
questions.audio: Was jou hande. Eet jou kos.
questions.memo: 'Was jou hande' (wash your hands) is said first, then 'Eet jou kos' (eat your food).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Staan op. Loop na die deur.
options: Stand up, walk to the door
Sit down, look at the door
questions.expected: Stand up, walk to the door
questions.memo: 'Staan op' = stand up; 'Loop na die deur' = walk to the door.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Maak die boek oop. Lees die storie.
options: Open the book, read the story
Close the book, draw a picture
Open the door, read the sign
questions.expected: Open the book, read the story
questions.memo: 'Maak die boek oop' = open the book; 'Lees die storie' = read the story.

questions.question: What two things were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Maak die venster toe. Sit op die mat.
options: Close the window, sit on the mat
Open the window, sit on the chair
Close the door, sit on the mat
questions.expected: Close the window, sit on the mat
questions.memo: 'Maak ... toe' = close; 'Sit op die mat' = sit on the mat.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Vat jou potlood. Teken 'n huis.
options: Take your pencil, draw a house
Take your pen, draw a dog
Take your book, read a story
questions.expected: Take your pencil, draw a house

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Tel die bal op. Gooi dit vir my.
options: Pick up the ball, throw it to me
Kick the ball, run to me
Pick up the book, give it to me
questions.expected: Pick up the ball, throw it to me

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do first?
questions.audio: Drink jou melk. Borsel jou tande.
questions.memo: The first instruction was 'Drink jou melk' (drink your milk).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Trek jou skoene aan. Loop buite toe.
options: Put on your shoes, walk outside
Take off your shoes, stay inside
Put on your hat, walk outside
questions.expected: Put on your shoes, walk outside

questions.question: Which step comes LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do last?
questions.audio: Was jou hande. Droog hulle af.
questions.memo: After washing ('Was jou hande'), the last step is 'Droog hulle af' (dry them).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Maak die deur oop. Roep die hond.
options: Open the door, call the dog
Close the door, feed the dog
Open the window, call the cat
questions.expected: Open the door, call the dog

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Sit die boek in die sak. Gee dit vir Ma.
options: Put the book in the bag, give it to Mom
Take the book out, give it to Dad
Put the pen in the bag, give it to Mom
questions.expected: Put the book in the bag, give it to Mom
questions.memo: 'Sit ... in die sak' = put in the bag, 'Gee dit vir Ma' = give it to Mom.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Staan in 'n ry. Wag vir jou beurt.
options: Stand in a line, wait for your turn
questions.expected: Stand in a line, wait for your turn
questions.memo: 'Staan in 'n ry' = stand in a line, 'Wag vir jou beurt' = wait for your turn.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Kleur die son geel. Kleur die gras groen.
options: Colour the sun yellow, the grass green
Colour the sun red, the grass blue
questions.expected: Colour the sun yellow, the grass green
questions.memo: 'Kleur ... geel' = colour yellow, 'gras groen' = grass green.

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do first?
questions.audio: Eet jou kos. Was jou bord.
questions.memo: First 'Eet jou kos' (eat your food), then 'Was jou bord' (wash your plate).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Vou die papier. Knip dit.
options: Fold the paper, draw on it

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Pak jou speelgoed weg. Gaan slaap.
options: Pack away your toys, go to sleep
Take out your toys, play more
questions.expected: Pack away your toys, go to sleep
questions.memo: 'Pak ... weg' = pack away, 'Gaan slaap' = go to sleep.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Skryf jou naam. Trek 'n streep daaronder.
options: Write your name, draw a line under it
Write a number, draw a box
questions.expected: Write your name, draw a line under it
questions.memo: 'Skryf jou naam' = write your name, 'Trek 'n streep daaronder' = draw a line under it.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Tel tot drie. Spring dan hoog.
options: Count to three, then jump high
questions.expected: Count to three, then jump high
questions.memo: 'Tel tot drie' = count to three, 'Spring dan hoog' = then jump high.

AF.G2.LUI.02.title: Identifiseer voorwerp uit beskrywing (identify object from description)
AF.G2.LUI.02.description: Listen to a simple Afrikaans description and choose the object it describes.
AF.G2.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: Re-read the description one clue at a time and rule options out clue by clue.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rond en rooi. Jy speel daarmee.
questions.memo: Round, red and you play with it = 'n bal (a ball).

questions.question: What animal is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vier bene. Dit blaf. Dit is 'n troeteldier.
questions.memo: Four legs, it barks (blaf), a pet = 'n hond (a dog).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is geel. Jy eet dit. 'n Aap hou daarvan.
questions.memo: Yellow, you eat it, a monkey likes it = 'n piesang (a banana).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit skyn in die dag. Dit is warm en geel.
questions.memo: Shines in the day, warm and yellow = die son (the sun).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy trek dit aan jou voete. Jy stap daarmee.
questions.memo: You put them on your feet and walk = skoene (shoes).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vlerke. Dit kan vlieg. Dit sing.
questions.memo: Wings + flies + sings = a bird ('n voël).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is wit. Jy drink dit. Dit kom van 'n koei.
questions.memo: White + you drink it + comes from a cow = milk (melk).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het baie blare. Dit is hoog. Voëls sit daarin.
questions.memo: Many leaves + tall + birds sit in it = a tree ('n boom).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy sit daarop. Dit het vier bene.
questions.memo: You sit on it + four legs = a chair. (A bed has legs too, but you lie on it.)

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is koud en wit. Dit val in die winter.
questions.memo: Cold + white + falls in winter = snow (sneeu).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vier wiele. Dit ry op die pad.
questions.memo: Four wheels + drives on the road = a car. A bike has two wheels.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is groen. Dit spring. Dit woon by die water.
questions.memo: Green + jumps + lives by water = a frog ('n padda).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy lees dit. Dit het baie bladsye.
questions.memo: You read it + many pages = a book ('n boek).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit skyn in die nag. Dit is in die lug.
questions.memo: Shines at night + in the sky = the moon (die maan). The sun shines in the day.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is lank en geel. 'n Aap eet dit.
questions.memo: Long + yellow + a monkey eats it = a banana ('n piesang).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit blaf. Dit het vier bene. Dit is 'n troeteldier.
questions.memo: Barks + four legs + a pet = a dog ('n hond).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy trek dit oor jou kop aan. Dit hou jou warm.
questions.memo: You pull it over your head + keeps you warm = a jersey ('n trui).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rond. Dit wys die tyd.
questions.memo: Round + shows the time = a clock/watch ('n horlosie).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rooi en rond. Dit groei op 'n boom. Jy eet dit.
questions.memo: Red + round + grows on a tree + you eat it = an apple. (A ball isn't food.)

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het baie kleure. Jy sien dit ná die reën.
questions.memo: Many colours + after the rain = a rainbow ('n reënboog).

AF.G2.LUI.03.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n storie — gebeure in volgorde (story comprehension: events in order)
AF.G2.LUI.03.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans story and answer comprehension and ordering questions.
AF.G2.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Re-read and pause after each event. Ask 'what happened next?' before the ordering question.

questions.question: What did Tom do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: The story says 'Tom het opgestaan' first — he got up first.

questions.question: What did Tom do LAST?
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: 'Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan' is the last event — he went to school last.

questions.question: Why was the girl happy?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Lisa het 'n present gekry. Sy was baie bly.
questions.memo: 'Lisa het 'n present gekry' — she got a present, so she was happy (bly).

questions.question: Where did the family go?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die gesin het strand toe gegaan. Hulle het in die see geswem.
questions.memo: 'strand toe gegaan' = went to the beach; they swam in the sea.

questions.question: What did the dog do after it ate?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die hond het kos geëet. Toe het hy gaan slaap.
questions.memo: 'Toe het hy gaan slaap' — after eating, the dog went to sleep.

questions.question: What happened LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Ben het 'n bal gevat. Hy het buite gaan speel. Toe het dit gereën.
questions.memo: The last event was 'Toe het dit gereën' (then it rained).

questions.question: What did Mia do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Mia het kos gemaak. Sy het die tafel gedek. Toe het hulle geëet.

questions.question: Why did Mom comfort the boy?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die seun het geval. Hy het gehuil. Ma het hom getroos.
questions.memo: He fell ('het geval') and cried ('het gehuil'), so Mom comforted him.

questions.question: What did they do AFTER baking the cake?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die gesin het 'n koek gebak. Hulle het kersies opgesit. Toe het hulle gesing.
questions.memo: After baking ('gebak'), they put on candles ('kersies opgesit').

questions.question: Where did Sara go in the end?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Sara het haar tas gepak. Sy het bus toe geloop. Toe het sy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: In the end 'sy het skool toe gegaan' (she went to school).

questions.question: What did the dog do with the bone?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die hond het 'n been gekry. Hy het dit begrawe. Toe het hy gaan slaap.

questions.question: How did Tom feel the next day?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom was siek. Hy het medisyne gedrink. Die volgende dag was hy beter.
questions.memo: 'die volgende dag was hy beter' = the next day he was better.

questions.question: What washed the castle away?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die kinders het sand gegrawe. Hulle het 'n kasteel gebou. Die see het dit weggespoel.
questions.memo: 'Die see het dit weggespoel' = the sea washed it away.

questions.question: What grew?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Lisa het 'n saad geplant. Sy het dit natgemaak. 'n Blom het gegroei.
questions.memo: 'n Blom het gegroei' = a flower grew.

questions.question: What did the bird do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die voël het takkies gevat. Sy het 'n nes gebou. Toe het sy eiers gelê.
questions.memo: First 'takkies gevat' (took twigs), then built the nest, then laid eggs.

questions.question: Why did Dad wash the car again?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Pappa het die kar gewas. Dit het vuil geword in die modder. Hy het dit weer gewas.
options: It got dirty in the mud
questions.expected: It got dirty in the mud
questions.memo: 'Dit het vuil geword in die modder' = it got dirty in the mud, so he washed it again.

questions.question: Did the cat catch the mouse?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die kat het 'n muis gesien. Sy het agter hom gehardloop. Die muis het weggekom.
questions.memo: 'Die muis het weggekom' = the mouse got away, so the cat did not catch it.

questions.question: What did they eat?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Ons het na die dieretuin gegaan. Ons het die olifante gesien. Toe het ons roomys geëet.

questions.question: Why did the boy fall?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die seun het sy fiets gery. Hy het te vinnig gery. Hy het geval.
questions.memo: 'Hy het te vinnig gery' = he rode too fast, so he fell.

questions.question: What did they see at the end?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Eers het dit gereën. Toe het die son uitgekom. Toe het ons 'n reënboog gesien.
questions.memo: After the rain and sun, 'ons het 'n reënboog gesien' (we saw a rainbow).

AF.G2.TAA.02.title: Tydlyne en volgorde (timelines & sequence)
AF.G2.TAA.02.description: Understand and use Afrikaans sequence words: Eers ... en toe ... Daarna.

AF.G2.TAA.05.title: Koppelwerkwoord 'is' (linking verb 'is')
AF.G2.TAA.05.description: Understand and use the Afrikaans linking verb 'is'.
AF.G2.TAA.05.recovery_strategy: Join a subject to a describing word with 'is' (Sy + is + bly).

questions.question: Finish: 'Sy ___ gelukkig.' (She is happy)
questions.memo: 'is' links them: 'Sy is gelukkig' = 'She is happy'.

questions.question: What does 'Die hond is groot' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Die hond is groot'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'is' means 'is': 'Die hond is groot' = 'The dog is big'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek ___ moeg.' (I am tired)
questions.memo: Afrikaans uses 'is' for 'am/is/are': 'Ek is moeg' = 'I am tired'.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'is' correctly?
questions.memo: 'Die kat is klein' = 'The cat is small'. 'is' goes after the subject.

questions.question: What does 'Die kos is lekker' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Die kos is lekker'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'lekker' = nice/tasty: 'Die kos is lekker' = 'The food is nice'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die bal ___ rond.' (is round)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Die bal ___ rond.
questions.memo: 'is' links the thing to its description: 'Die bal is rond' (The ball is round).

questions.question: What does 'Ek is honger' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Die kinders ___ bly.' (are happy)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Die kinders ___ bly.
questions.memo: 'is' works for one or many: 'Die kinders is bly' (The children are happy).

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'is' correctly?
questions.memo: Order: thing + 'is' + describing word: 'Die son is warm'.

questions.question: What does 'Sy is my maat' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'is' = is: 'Sy is my maat' = 'She is my friend'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die water ___ koud.' (is cold)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Die water ___ koud.
questions.memo: 'is' links water to 'koud' (cold): 'Die water is koud'.

questions.question: In 'Die hond is groot', which word is the linking word?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word is the linking word?
questions.memo: 'is' is the linking verb — it joins 'die hond' to 'groot'.

questions.question: What does 'Dit is reg' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.memo: thing + 'is' + describing word: 'Die blom is mooi' (The flower is pretty).

AF.G3.LEE.02.description: Read a short Afrikaans text and answer comprehension questions, including why.
AF.G3.LEE.02.recovery_strategy: Re-read the sentence that gives the reason. Underline cause-and-effect words.

questions.question: Read: 'Thabo huil, want hy het sy bal verloor.' Why is Thabo crying?
questions.context: Text: 'Thabo huil, want hy het sy bal verloor.'
questions.memo: 'want hy het sy bal verloor' = because he lost his ball.

questions.context: Text: 'Die kinders dra truie, want dit is koud.'

questions.context: Text: 'Die voël kan nie vlieg nie, want sy vlerk is seer.'

questions.context: Text: 'Die hond blaf, want iemand klop aan die deur.'
questions.memo: 'want iemand klop aan die deur' = because someone is knocking.

questions.question: Read: 'Sara is moeg, want sy het die hele dag gespeel.' Why is Sara tired?
questions.context: Text: 'Sara is moeg, want sy het die hele dag gespeel.'
questions.memo: 'want sy het die hele dag gespeel' = because she played all day.

questions.context: Text: 'Die ys smelt, want die son is warm.'

questions.question: Read: 'Pieter dra 'n bril, want hy kan nie goed sien nie.' Why does Pieter wear glasses?
questions.context: Text: 'Pieter dra 'n bril, want hy kan nie goed sien nie.'

questions.question: Read: 'Die kinders is opgewonde, want môre is dit vakansie.' Why are they excited?
questions.context: Text: 'Die kinders is opgewonde, want môre is dit vakansie.'

questions.question: Read: 'Ma maak die venster toe, want dit is koud.' Why does Mom close the window?
questions.context: Text: 'Ma maak die venster toe, want dit is koud.'
questions.memo: 'want dit is koud' = because it is cold.

questions.question: Read: 'Die blare val, want dit is herfs.' Why are the leaves falling?
questions.context: Text: 'Die blare val, want dit is herfs.'
questions.memo: 'want dit is herfs' = because it is autumn.

questions.context: Text: 'Tom drink water, want hy is dors ná die wedloop.'

questions.expected: He is thirsty after the race
questions.memo: 'want hy is dors' = because he is thirsty.

questions.question: Read: 'Die voël bou 'n nes, want sy gaan eiers lê.' Why does the bird build a nest?

questions.context: Text: 'Die plant het verlep, want niemand het dit natgemaak nie.'
questions.memo: 'want niemand het dit natgemaak nie' = because nobody watered it.

questions.question: Read: 'Die kar het gestop, want die petrol is op.' Why did the car stop?

questions.question: Why is the farmer happy?
questions.audio: Die boer is bly, want dit het gereën op sy plaas.
questions.memo: 'want dit het gereën' = because it rained — good for the farm.

questions.question: Why did Tom walk slowly?
questions.audio: Tom het stadig geloop, want sy been was seer.
questions.memo: 'want sy been was seer' = because his leg was sore.

questions.question: Why did the teacher praise the children?
questions.audio: Die kinders het hard gewerk. Daarom het die juffrou hulle geprys.
questions.memo: 'Daarom' (that's why) — she praised them because they worked hard.

questions.question: Who is the jersey for?
questions.audio: Ouma het 'n trui gebrei vir die nuwe baba.
questions.memo: 'vir die nuwe baba' = for the new baby.

questions.question: Why did the fish swim away?
questions.audio: Die vis het weggeswem, want die kind het te naby gekom.
questions.memo: 'want die kind het te naby gekom' = because the child came too close.

questions.question: Why did Pieter have to go back?
questions.audio: Pieter het sy boek by die huis vergeet. Hy moes dit gaan haal.
options: He forgot his book at home
questions.expected: He forgot his book at home
questions.memo: 'het sy boek vergeet' = forgot his book, so he had to fetch it.

questions.question: Why did everyone clap?
questions.audio: Almal het hande geklap, want die span het gewen.
questions.memo: 'want die span het gewen' = because the team won.

questions.question: Why did the baby cry?
questions.audio: Die baba het gehuil, want sy was honger.
questions.memo: 'want sy was honger' = because she was hungry.

questions.question: When did the man open the umbrella?
questions.audio: Die man het 'n sambreel oopgemaak toe dit begin reën het.
questions.memo: 'toe dit begin reën het' = when it began to rain.

questions.question: Why did the cat sit on the roof?
questions.audio: Die kat het op die warm dak gesit om in die son te lê.
questions.memo: 'om in die son te lê' = to lie in the sun.

questions.question: Why was the friend happy?
questions.audio: Lebo het haar speelgoed gedeel. Daarom was haar maat baie bly.
questions.memo: 'het haar speelgoed gedeel' = shared her toys; 'Daarom' = that's why the friend was happy.

AF.G3.LUI.02.title: Voorspel wat volgende gebeur (predict the next event)
AF.G3.LUI.02.description: Listen to part of an Afrikaans story and predict what happens next.
AF.G3.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: Recap what happened, then ask 'what makes sense next?' Rule out options that do not fit.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then predict what comes next.
questions.audio: Lebo is baie honger. Sy maak vir haar 'n toebroodjie.
questions.memo: She is hungry and made a sandwich, so next she will eat it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Dit is donker. Tom klim in sy bed.
questions.memo: It is dark and he climbed into bed, so next he will sleep.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Die bal rol na die straat toe. Die hond hardloop agterna.
options: The dog runs into the street
questions.expected: The dog runs into the street
questions.memo: The ball rolled to the street and the dog runs after it, so it will go into the street.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Die wolke word donker. Die wind waai sterk.
questions.memo: Dark clouds and strong wind are clues that it will rain.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Die juffrou sê: 'Maak julle boeke oop.'
questions.memo: The teacher asked them to open their books, so they will do it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die seun trek sy swembroek aan. Hy stap na die swembad.
questions.memo: Swimsuit + walking to the pool → he will swim next.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die telefoon lui.
questions.memo: When the phone rings, someone usually answers it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die seun blaas die kersies op die koek.
questions.memo: After blowing out the candles, they cut and eat the cake.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Sy maak die yskas oop en haal die melk uit.
questions.memo: Taking milk out of the fridge → she will pour or drink it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die baba is moeg en vryf haar oë.
questions.memo: Tired + rubbing eyes → she will fall asleep.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die kinders sit hul jasse aan en stap na die deur.
questions.memo: Coats on + walking to the door → they go outside.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Hy gooi sade vir die hoenders.
questions.memo: Throwing seeds for the chickens → they will eat them.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die juffrou deel die toetse uit.
questions.memo: Handing out tests → the children will write.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Dit is baie warm. Die kind kry 'n roomys.
options: The child eats the ice cream
questions.expected: The child eats the ice cream
questions.memo: Hot day + got ice cream → the child eats it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die hond sien sy bak met kos.
questions.memo: Seeing its food bowl → the dog will eat.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die wedloop gaan begin. Die hardlopers staan reg.
questions.memo: Race about to start + runners ready → they start running.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Sy vat 'n potlood en 'n stuk papier.
questions.memo: Pencil + paper → she will draw or write.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die emmer is amper vol water en die kraan loop nog.
questions.memo: Almost full + tap still running → it will overflow.

questions.question: What might happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die seun klim hoog in die boom, maar die tak kraak.
questions.memo: A cracking branch is a warning — it might break and he could fall.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Donker wolke pak saam en daar is weerlig.
questions.memo: Dark clouds + lightning → a storm with rain is coming.

AF.G3.LUI.03.title: Luister na niefiksie en som op (non-fiction: answer & summarise)
AF.G3.LUI.03.description: Listen to short Afrikaans non-fiction and answer / summarise.
AF.G3.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Re-read each fact. Ask 'what is the whole thing about?' before summary choices.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the facts, then pick the best summary.
questions.audio: Olifante is groot diere. Hulle woon in troppe. Hulle eet gras en blare.

questions.question: What do elephants eat?
questions.audio: Olifante is groot diere. Hulle woon in troppe. Hulle eet gras en blare.
questions.memo: 'Hulle eet gras en blare' = they eat grass and leaves.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the facts, then pick the best summary.
questions.audio: Die son gee lig. Die son gee warmte. Plante het die son nodig om te groei.
questions.memo: All the facts are about die son (the sun).

questions.question: Why do plants need the sun?
questions.audio: Die son gee lig. Die son gee warmte. Plante het die son nodig om te groei.
questions.memo: 'om te groei' = in order to grow. Plants need the sun to grow.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the facts, then pick the best summary.
questions.audio: Visse leef in die water. Hulle swem met hul vinne. Hulle asem deur kieue.
questions.memo: All the facts are about visse (fish).

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Voëls het vlerke. Hulle kan vlieg. Hulle bou neste in bome.

questions.question: Where do birds build nests?
questions.audio: Voëls het vlerke. Hulle kan vlieg. Hulle bou neste in bome.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Die maan skyn in die nag. Dit gee nie sy eie lig nie. Dit weerkaats die son se lig.
questions.memo: All sentences are about die maan (the moon).

questions.question: Why are bees important?
questions.audio: Bye maak heuning. Hulle help blomme om vrugte te maak. Bye is baie belangrik.
options: They make honey and help flowers
questions.expected: They make honey and help flowers
questions.memo: Bees make honey and help flowers make fruit — that's why they're important.

questions.question: What do plants need?
questions.audio: Plante het water, son en grond nodig. Sonder water sal hulle doodgaan.
questions.memo: 'water, son en grond' = water, sun and soil.

questions.question: Where does the hippo live?
questions.audio: Die seekoei is 'n groot dier. Dit woon in die rivier. Dit eet gras snags.
questions.memo: 'woon in die rivier' = lives in the river.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Reën kom uit die wolke. Dit vul die riviere en damme. Ons drink van hierdie water.
questions.memo: Rain filling rivers and dams that we drink from = about where our water comes from.

questions.question: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.audio: Spinnekoppe het agt bene. Hulle spin webbe om insekte te vang.

questions.question: What is the sun?
questions.audio: Die son is 'n groot bal van vuur. Dit is baie ver van die aarde af.
questions.memo: ''n groot bal van vuur' = a big ball of fire.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Skilpaaie dra hul huise op hul rûe. Hulle loop baie stadig.
questions.memo: Carrying their house + walking slowly = about tortoises (skilpaaie).

questions.question: What do we make from milk?
questions.audio: Melk kom van koeie. Ons maak kaas en botter van melk.
questions.memo: 'kaas en botter van melk' = cheese and butter from milk.

questions.question: What happens in autumn?
questions.audio: Die herfs is wanneer blare verkleur en val. Daarna kom die winter.
questions.memo: In herfs (autumn), leaves change colour and fall.

questions.question: What is a lion called?
questions.audio: Diere wat vleis eet, word roofdiere genoem. 'n Leeu is 'n roofdier.
questions.memo: Animals that eat meat are 'roofdiere' (predators) — a lion is one.

questions.question: What is ice?
questions.audio: Water kan 'n vaste stof, 'n vloeistof of 'n gas wees. Ys is bevrore water.
questions.memo: 'Ys is bevrore water' = ice is frozen water.

questions.question: Why should we brush our teeth?
questions.audio: Ons tande help ons om kos te kou. Daarom moet ons hulle borsel.
options: So they stay healthy to chew food
questions.expected: So they stay healthy to chew food
questions.memo: Teeth help us chew, so we brush them to keep them healthy.

AF.G3.TAA.01.title: Toekomende tyd (future tense: sal)
AF.G3.TAA.01.description: Understand and form the Afrikaans future tense with 'sal'.
AF.G3.TAA.01.recovery_strategy: Tie 'sal' to something not yet done (later/môre). Contrast with the past 'het'.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the FUTURE (will happen)?
questions.memo: 'Ek sal speel' = 'I will play' (future). 'sal' shows it has not happened yet.

questions.question: How do you say 'She will come'?
Finish: 'Ek ___ môre swem.' (I will swim tomorrow)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes it future? Ek ___ môre swem.
questions.memo: 'sal' makes the future: 'Ek sal môre swem' = 'I will swim tomorrow'.

questions.question: What does 'Ons sal eet' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ons sal eet'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Hulle ___ later kom.' (They will come later)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes it future? Hulle ___ later kom.
questions.memo: 'Hulle sal later kom' = 'They will come later'.

questions.question: Put 'Ek speel' into the future.
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'I will play'?
questions.memo: Future = 'sal' + verb: 'Ek sal speel' (I will play).

questions.question: Finish: 'Hy ___ môre kom.' (will come)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes the future? Hy ___ môre kom.
questions.memo: 'sal' makes the future: 'Hy sal môre kom' (He will come tomorrow).

questions.question: What does 'Sy sal sing' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Ons ___ see toe gaan.' (will go)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes the future? Ons ___ see toe gaan.
questions.memo: 'sal' makes the future: 'Ons sal see toe gaan' (We will go to the sea).

questions.question: Which sentence is in the FUTURE?
questions.memo: 'sal' shows the future: 'Hulle sal eet' (They will eat).

questions.question: Put 'Die hond blaf' into the future.
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'The dog will bark'?
questions.memo: 'sal' + verb = future: 'Die hond sal blaf' (The dog will bark).

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek ___ jou help.' (will help)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes the future? Ek ___ jou help.
questions.memo: 'sal' = will: 'Ek sal jou help' (I will help you).

questions.question: What does 'Jy sal val' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Which word makes a sentence about the FUTURE?
Finish: 'Hulle ___ later speel.' (will play)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes the future? Hulle ___ later speel.

questions.question: What does 'Ons sal wen' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Put 'Sy lees' into the future.
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'She will read'?
questions.memo: 'sal' + verb = future: 'Sy sal lees' (She will read).

questions.question: Finish: 'Dit ___ môre reën.' (will rain)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes the future? Dit ___ môre reën.
questions.memo: 'sal' makes the future: 'Dit sal môre reën' (It will rain tomorrow).

questions.question: 'Ek sal môre swem.' Which words show the FUTURE?
questions.memo: 'sal' (will) and 'môre' (tomorrow) both point to the future.

questions.question: What does 'Hy sal 'n dokter word' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'sal ... word' = will become: 'Hy sal 'n dokter word'.

AF.G3.TAA.02.title: Al drie tye (present, past, future contrasted)
AF.G3.TAA.02.description: Tell apart and choose the right Afrikaans tense.
AF.G3.TAA.02.recovery_strategy: Anchor each tense to a time word: nou (present), gister (past), môre (future).

questions.question: Which sentence is in the PAST?
questions.memo: 'Ek het geëet' = 'I ate' (past). 'het ge-' shows the past.

questions.question: Which time word goes with 'Ek het gespeel'?
questions.ruby_prompt: 'Ek het gespeel' is past. Which time word fits?

questions.question: Finish for tomorrow: 'Ek ___ môre gaan.'
questions.ruby_prompt: 'môre' = tomorrow. Which word fits? Ek ___ môre gaan.
questions.memo: 'môre' needs the future: 'Ek sal môre gaan' = 'I will go tomorrow'.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the PRESENT (happening now)?
Which time word goes with 'Ons sal swem'?
questions.ruby_prompt: 'Ons sal swem' is future. Which time word fits?

questions.question: Which sentence is in the FUTURE?
questions.memo: 'sal' = future (will eat). 'het ge-' = past; plain verb = present.

questions.question: Which time word goes with 'Sy sal kom'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which time word fits the future?
questions.memo: 'sal' is future, so it pairs with 'môre' (tomorrow).

questions.question: Finish for yesterday: 'Ek ___ gister gespeel.'
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes the past? Ek ___ gister gespeel.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the PRESENT (now)?
questions.memo: Plain verb 'speel' = present (now). 'het ge-' = past; 'sal' = future.

questions.question: Which time word goes with 'Ek het geslaap'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which time word fits the past?
questions.memo: 'het ge-' is past, so it pairs with 'gister' (yesterday).

questions.question: Change to PAST: 'Ek eet' → ?
Change to FUTURE: 'Sy sing' → ?
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'She will sing'?
questions.memo: Future = 'sal' + verb: 'Sy sal sing' (She will sing).

questions.question: Finish for now: 'Die kinders ___ buite.' (play, present)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word fits the present? Die kinders ___ buite.
questions.memo: Present (now) uses the plain verb: 'Die kinders speel buite'.

questions.question: 'Hulle het gister gespeel.' Is this past, present or future?
'Ons sal môre swem.' Is this past, present or future?
'Ek eet nou kos.' Is this past, present or future?
Finish for tomorrow: 'Sy ___ môre dans.'
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word makes the future? Sy ___ môre dans.

questions.question: Which is the PAST of 'Hy loop'?
Put in order: present, past, future of 'speel'.
questions.ruby_prompt: Which order is present, past, future?
questions.memo: Present: speel. Past: het gespeel. Future: sal speel.

questions.question: Finish: 'Gister het ek gespeel, vandag speel ek, en môre ___ ek speel.'

AF.G3.TAA.03.title: Lidwoorde ('n, die)
AF.G3.TAA.03.description: Use the Afrikaans articles ''n' and 'die' correctly.
AF.G3.TAA.03.recovery_strategy: Use ''n' for any one (a dog) and 'die' for a specific one (the dog we know).

questions.question: What does ''n appel' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: ''n appel'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'die appel' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'die appel'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek sien ___ hond.' (a dog — any dog)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article means 'a'? Ek sien ___ hond.
questions.memo: ''n' means 'a': 'Ek sien 'n hond' = 'I see a dog'.

questions.question: Finish: '___ son skyn.' (The sun — there is only one)
questions.memo: There is only one sun, so use 'die': 'Die son skyn' = 'The sun shines'.

questions.question: Which means 'a book' (any book)?
Finish: 'Ek het ___ kat.' (a cat — any cat)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article fits? Ek het ___ kat.
questions.memo: ''n' = a/an (any one): 'Ek het 'n kat' (I have a cat).

questions.question: Finish: '___ maan skyn helder.' (The moon — only one)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article fits? ___ maan skyn helder.
questions.memo: 'Die' = the (a specific one): 'Die maan skyn helder'.

questions.question: What does ''n hond' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'die hond' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Which means 'an apple' (any apple)?
Which means 'the apple' (a specific one)?
Finish: 'Sy lees ___ boek.' (a book — any book)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article fits? Sy lees ___ boek.

questions.question: When do you use 'die' instead of ''n'?
questions.memo: 'die' (the) points to a specific thing; ''n' (a) is any one.

questions.question: Finish: 'Kyk na ___ voël daar!' (the bird — that specific one)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article fits? Kyk na ___ voël daar!
questions.memo: You mean a specific bird, so use 'die': 'die voël daar'.

questions.question: ''n' is like which English word?
'die' is like which English word?
Finish: 'Daar is ___ son in die lug.' (the sun — only one)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which article fits? Daar is ___ son in die lug.
questions.memo: There is only one sun, so use 'die': 'die son'.

questions.question: Which is correct for 'a car' (any car)?
First time you see a dog: 'Ek sien ___ hond.' Which article?
questions.memo: When you mention something for the first time, use ''n' (a). Later you can say 'die' (the).

questions.question: 'Ek het 'n bal. Die bal is rooi.' Why change from ''n' to 'die'?
options: the second time, it's a specific ball we know
questions.expected: the second time, it's a specific ball we know
questions.memo: First time: ''n bal' (a ball). Once we know which ball, we say 'die bal' (the ball).

AF.G3.TAA.04.title: Trappe van vergelyking (degrees of comparison)
AF.G3.TAA.04.description: Understand and use Afrikaans degrees of comparison.
AF.G3.TAA.04.recovery_strategy: Line up three things small-to-big: groot, groter, grootste. Stress -er and -ste.

questions.question: Finish: groot, groter, ___
Which word means 'faster'?
Finish: 'Die olifant is ___ as die hond.' (bigger)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'bigger'? Die olifant is ___ as die hond.
questions.memo: Comparing two things uses -er: 'groter as' = 'bigger than'.

questions.question: Which word means 'the smallest'?
Finish: lank, langer, ___
Finish: klein, kleiner, ___
Which word means 'faster'?
Finish: 'Die muis is ___ as die kat.' (smaller)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'smaller'? Die muis is ___ as die kat.

questions.question: Which word means 'the fastest'?
Finish: warm, warmer, ___
Finish: 'Die olifant is die ___ dier.' (biggest)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'biggest'? Die olifant is die ___ dier.

questions.question: Which shows MORE (comparing two): 'groot' or 'groter'?
questions.memo: 'groter' (bigger) compares two things. 'groot' is just big.

questions.question: Finish: vinnig, vinniger, ___
Which word means 'the longest/tallest'?
Finish: 'Hierdie boom is ___ as daardie een.' (taller)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'taller'? Hierdie boom is ___ as daardie een.
questions.memo: Comparing two trees: 'langer as' = taller than.

questions.question: To say 'the most' of something, which ending do you add?
To compare just TWO things, which ending do you add?
Finish: koud, kouer, ___
'Sara is lank. Tom is langer. Ben is die ___.'
questions.ruby_prompt: Who is the tallest — which word fits?
questions.memo: Three people: lank → langer → langste (Ben is the tallest).

questions.question: Which is correct: 'Die muis is die ___ dier' (smallest)?

AF.G3.TAA.05.title: Aanwysende voornaamwoorde (demonstratives)
AF.G3.TAA.05.description: Understand and use Afrikaans demonstratives: hierdie, daardie, dit.
AF.G3.TAA.05.recovery_strategy: Point near (hierdie) and far (daardie) with real objects. Practise the pair together.

questions.question: What does 'hierdie' mean?
What does 'daardie' mean?
Finish: '___ boek hier is myne.' (This book here)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'this' (near)? ___ boek hier is myne.

questions.question: Finish: '___ hond daar is groot.' (That dog there)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'that' (far)? ___ hond daar is groot.

questions.question: What does 'dit' mean?
Finish: '___ appel hier is rooi.' (This apple here)
Finish: '___ huis daar oorkant is groot.' (That house there)
What does 'hierdie' mean?
What does 'daardie' mean?
You point at a book right next to you. 'hierdie' or 'daardie'?
You point at a tree far away. 'hierdie' or 'daardie'?
What does 'dit' mean?
questions.memo: 'dit' means 'it', as in 'Dit reën' (It is raining).

questions.question: Finish: '___ skoene hier pas my.' (These shoes here)
questions.memo: 'Hierdie' works for one or many near you: 'Hierdie skoene hier'.

questions.question: 'Hierdie' is for things that are...?
'Daardie' is for things that are...?
Finish: '___ kar daar is myne.' (That car there)
Which means 'this dog' (right here)?
Which means 'that bird' (over there)?
What does 'Dit is warm vandag' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'Dit' = it: 'Dit is warm vandag' = 'It is warm today'.

questions.question: 'Hierdie' is near, 'daardie' is far. Which for a star in the sky?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word for a far-away star?
questions.memo: A star is very far away, so 'daardie ster' (that star).

AF.G3.TAA.06.title: Vraagsinne (Watter? Waarom?)
AF.G3.TAA.06.description: Understand and use a variety of Afrikaans question words.
AF.G3.TAA.06.recovery_strategy: Tie 'Watter?' to a choice between options and 'Waarom?' to a reason (omdat ...).

questions.question: What does 'Waarom?' ask for?
questions.ruby_prompt: The question word 'Waarom?' — what does it ask for?
questions.memo: 'Waarom?' means 'Why?' — it asks for a reason (answered with 'omdat ...').

questions.question: What does 'Watter?' ask for?
questions.ruby_prompt: The question word 'Watter?' — what does it ask for?
questions.memo: 'Watter?' means 'Which?' — it asks you to choose between options.

questions.question: Which question fits the answer 'Omdat dit gereën het' (Because it rained)?
questions.ruby_prompt: The answer gives a reason. Which question fits?

questions.context: Op 'n koue wintersaand het oupa Pieter vir die laaste keer voor die kaggel gesit. Sy familie was om hom — sy seuns, kleinkinders en sy ou hond, Bossie. Hy het van 'n nag op die savanne vertel, toe hy en sy vriende met 'n leeu in die naburige bos gestaar het. Niemand het beweeg nie. Die leeu het gedraai en weggegaan. Daardie nag het hy geleer dat moed nie die afwesigheid van vrees is nie, maar om reg te doen ten spyte van vrees. Toe sy stem stil word, het sy kleindogter haar hand op syne gelê. 'Dankie Oupa,' het sy gefluister. Hy het geglimlag en sy oë toegemaak. Buite het die wind die laaste blaar van die boom afgeruk.

AF.G7.LET.02.title: Tema en boodskap

AF.G7.LET.02.recovery_strategy: Die tema is die groot idee waaroor die teks regtig gaan (bv. moed, vriendskap). Die intrige is net wat gebeur.

questions.question: Wat is die tema van die gedeelte?
questions.memo: Sello hou aan ondanks mislukking — die tema is deursettingsvermoë.
questions.context: Keer op keer het Sello geval terwyl hy leer fiets ry. Sy knieë was stukkend, maar elke keer het hy weer opgeklim. Teen sononder kon hy ry.

questions.question: Wat is die boodskap van die gedeelte?
questions.memo: Die boodskap is dat volharding beloon word.
questions.context: Keer op keer het Sello geval terwyl hy leer fiets ry, maar elke keer het hy weer opgeklim. Teen sononder kon hy ry.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Amahle deel met haar vriendin — die tema is vrygewigheid.
questions.context: Toe Amahle se vriendin se huis afgebrand het, het Amahle haar eie speelgoed en klere gegee om te help.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Almal werk saam — die tema is samewerking.
questions.context: Die hele dorp het saamgestaan om die rivier skoon te maak. Wat een mens nie kon doen nie, kon almal saam.

questions.question: Wat is die boodskap?
questions.memo: Die boodskap is die krag van samewerking.
questions.context: Wat een mens nie kon doen nie, kon almal saam.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Die storie gaan oor eerlikheid en gewete.
questions.context: Jabu het gejok oor wie die venster gebreek het. Later het sy gewete hom so gepla dat hy die waarheid moes vertel.

questions.question: Wat is die boodskap?
questions.memo: Die boodskap is dat eerlikheid die regte keuse is.
questions.context: Jabu het gejok, maar sy gewete het hom gepla totdat hy die waarheid vertel het.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Die boom gee sonder om terug te vra — onselfsugtige gee.
questions.context: Die ou boom het skaduwee gegee, voëls gehuisves en vrugte gedra vir almal, sonder om ooit iets terug te vra.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Die klas aanvaar die nuwe leerder — die tema is aanvaarding.
questions.context: Al was die nuwe leerder anders en het hy 'n ander taal gepraat, het die klas hom verwelkom en vriende geword.

questions.question: Wat is die boodskap?
questions.memo: Die boodskap is om ander te aanvaar.
questions.context: Al was die nuwe leerder anders, het die klas hom verwelkom en vriende geword.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Die storie wys die waarde van spaar — spaarsaamheid.
questions.context: Ouma het altyd gesê: spaar 'n deel van alles wat jy kry. Toe die droogte kom, het haar spaargeld die gesin gered.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Die tema is om aan jou drome vas te hou.
questions.context: Selfs toe almal vir hom gelag het, het die seun aangehou droom om 'n wetenskaplike te word — en eendag het hy.

questions.expected: Tema is die groot idee; intrige is wat gebeur
questions.memo: Die tema is die onderliggende idee; die intrige is die reeks gebeure.

questions.context: Die jong meisie het haar middagete met die honger straatkind gedeel, al was sy self honger.

questions.expected: Wees gaaf met ander, selfs as dit moeilik is
questions.memo: Die boodskap is om medelye te toon.
questions.context: Die jong meisie het haar kos met die honger kind gedeel, al was sy self honger.

questions.question: Wat is die tema?
questions.memo: Die fabel se tema is dat volharding wen.
questions.context: Die haas het gespog en geslaap, maar die stadige skilpad het aangehou stap en die wedloop gewen.

questions.question: Wat is die les (boodskap) van die fabel?
questions.memo: Die boodskap: stadig maar seker bereik die doel.
questions.context: Die stadige skilpad het aangehou stap en die wedloop gewen.

questions.memo: Hulle maak vrede — die tema is vergifnis.

AF.G7.LUI.03.title: Luister na 'n gedig: bepaal betekenis
AF.G7.LUI.03.description: Luister na 'n kort gedig en bepaal die betekenis, stemming en boodskap.
AF.G7.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Luister vir gevoelswoorde en herhaling; vra jouself wat die digter laat voel of dink.

questions.question: Wat is die stemming van die gedig?
questions.memo: Woorde soos 'alleen', 'swaar' en 'koud' skep 'n hartseer stemming.
questions.audio: Die reën tik sag teen die ruit, / die wêreld is stil en koud. / Ek sit alleen en dink aan jou, / my hart is swaar en oud.

questions.question: Waaroor gaan die gedig hoofsaaklik?
questions.memo: Die spreker dink alleen aan iemand — dit gaan oor verlange.
questions.audio: Die reën tik sag teen die ruit, / die wêreld is stil en koud. / Ek sit alleen en dink aan jou, / my hart is swaar en oud.

questions.question: Wat is die stemming van die gedig?
questions.memo: Woorde soos 'lag', 'sing' en 'dans' skep 'n vrolike stemming.
questions.audio: Die son lag oor die groen veld, / die voëls sing in die bome. / My voete dans op die pad, / vandag is vol van drome.

questions.question: Wat doen die spreker se voete?
questions.memo: Die gedig sê die voete dans.
questions.audio: My voete dans op die pad, / vandag is vol van drome.

questions.question: Wat beteken die reël 'die wind fluister deur die gras'?
options: Die wind waai saggies en maak 'n sagte geluid
questions.expected: Die wind waai saggies en maak 'n sagte geluid
questions.memo: 'Fluister' is beeldspraak vir die sagte geluid van die wind.
questions.audio: Die wind fluister deur die gras, / sag soos 'n ou geheim.

questions.question: Watter gevoel skep die gedig?
questions.memo: Woorde soos 'vrede', 'rustig' en 'wag' skep 'n rustige gevoel.
questions.audio: Saans, wanneer die sterre blink, / vou die wêreld toe in vrede. / Die maan hou wag oor almal wat / nou rustig lê en slaap.

questions.question: Wat 'hou wag' in die gedig?
questions.memo: Die maan word voorgestel asof dit wag hou.
questions.audio: Die maan hou wag oor almal wat / nou rustig lê en slaap.

questions.question: Waaroor gaan die gedig?
questions.memo: Die saadjie wag en groei tot 'n boom — die tema is groei en geduld.
questions.audio: Klein saadjie in die donker grond, / jy wag en wag en groei. / Eendag staan jy hoog en trots, / 'n boom waar voëls kan broei.

questions.question: Wat word die saadjie aan die einde?
questions.audio: Eendag staan jy hoog en trots, / 'n boom waar voëls kan broei.

questions.question: Wat is die stemming?
questions.memo: Die hond wag tevergeefs — dit is 'n treurige beeld.
questions.audio: Die ou hond lê by die hek, / sy oë volg elke pad. / Hy wag al jare vir sy maat / wat nooit weer terugkom het.

questions.question: Vir wie wag die hond?
questions.memo: Die hond wag vir sy maat.
questions.audio: Hy wag al jare vir sy maat / wat nooit weer terugkom het.

questions.question: Wat beteken 'die berge dra 'n wit mus'?
options: Daar is sneeu op die berge
questions.expected: Daar is sneeu op die berge
questions.memo: Die 'wit mus' is 'n beeld vir sneeu op die berge.
questions.audio: In die winter dra die berge / 'n wit mus van sneeu.

questions.question: Watter seisoen beskryf die gedig?
questions.audio: In die winter dra die berge / 'n wit mus van sneeu.

questions.question: Wat is die boodskap van die gedig?
options: Hou aan probeer en moenie opgee nie
questions.expected: Hou aan probeer en moenie opgee nie
questions.memo: Die boodskap is volharding — staan op en probeer weer.
questions.audio: Moenie moed verloor as jy val, / staan op en probeer weer. / Elke meester wat jy bewonder / het ook eers moes leer.

questions.question: Wat moet jy doen as jy val, volgens die gedig?
questions.memo: Die gedig sê staan op en probeer weer.
questions.audio: Moenie moed verloor as jy val, / staan op en probeer weer.

questions.question: Wat is die stemming van die gedig?
questions.memo: Woorde soos 'bruis', 'lag' en 'speel' skep 'n lewendige stemming.
questions.audio: Die markplein bruis van stemme en kleur, / vrugte en blomme by elke deur. / Mense lag, kinders speel — / die dorp se hart klop hier in die geheel.

questions.question: Wat word vergelyk met 'die dorp se hart'?
questions.memo: Die markplein word die kloppende hart van die dorp genoem.
questions.audio: Mense lag, kinders speel — / die dorp se hart klop hier in die geheel.

questions.question: Waaroor gaan die gedig?
questions.memo: Die gedig eer ouma se sorgsame hande — dit gaan oor liefde.
questions.audio: My ouma se hande is vol rimpels, / maar sag soos 'n veer. / Hulle het brood geknie en trane gevee / vir baie jare se seer.

questions.question: Waarmee word ouma se hande vergelyk?
questions.memo: Die hande word met 'n veer vergelyk (sag).
questions.audio: My ouma se hande is vol rimpels, / maar sag soos 'n veer.

questions.question: Wat is die stemming van die gedig?
questions.memo: Vakansie en lag skep 'n opgewonde, blye stemming.
questions.audio: Die laaste skoolklok lui vandag, / ons pak ons boeke weg. / Vakansie wag met oop arms — / ons lag al op die pad!

AF.G7.LUI.04.title: Oorredingstegnieke en feit/mening

options: 'n Spesiale aanbod om jou te lok

questions.audio: Die maan draai om die aarde.

questions.question: Is hierdie 'n feit of 'n mening?
questions.audio: Hierdie is die mooiste fliek wat ek nog ooit gesien het.

questions.question: Watter woord wys dit is 'n mening?
questions.memo: 'Ek dink' wys dit is 'n mening, nie 'n bewysbare feit nie.

options: Jou oorreed om vir hom te stem

questions.question: Is hierdie 'n feit of 'n mening?
questions.audio: Suid-Afrika het elf amptelike tale.

questions.memo: 'Maklikste' verskil van mens tot mens — 'n mening.

questions.question: Is hierdie 'n feit of 'n mening?

AF.G8.LUI.01.title: Onderhoud en dialoog: kerngedagtes

questions.question: Wat is die gas se hoofpunt?
questions.memo: Die gas se hoofpunt is dat bome stede gesonder maak.
questions.audio: Onderhoudvoerder: Hoekom moet ons bome plant? Gas: Bome gee skoon lug, skaduwee en huisves voëls. Dit maak ons stede gesonder.

questions.question: Wie vra die vraag?
questions.audio: Onderhoudvoerder: Hoekom moet ons bome plant? Gas: Bome gee skoon lug en skaduwee.

questions.question: Noem een rede wat die gas gee.
questions.memo: Die gas noem skoon lug as een rede.
questions.audio: Gas: Bome gee skoon lug, skaduwee en huisves voëls.

questions.question: Wat is die gas se hoofpunt oor oefening?
options: Oefening is goed vir liggaam en gees
questions.expected: Oefening is goed vir liggaam en gees
questions.memo: Die gas se hoofpunt is dat oefening liggaam en gees bevoordeel.
questions.audio: Onderhoudvoerder: Hoekom is oefening belangrik? Gas: Gereelde oefening hou jou hart sterk, verbeter jou bui en help jou slaap.

questions.question: Watter voordeel noem die gas NIE?
questions.audio: Gas: Oefening hou jou hart sterk, verbeter jou bui en help jou slaap.

questions.question: Wat is die hoofpunt van die gesprek?

Hulle hou nie van kinders nie
questions.expected: Hulle wil die speelpark herstel vir die kinders
questions.memo: Albei stem saam: herstel die park vir veilige speel.
questions.audio: Lebo: Ek dink ons moet die ou speelpark herstel. Sipho: Ja, dan het die kinders 'n veilige plek om te speel.

questions.question: Stem Sipho saam met Lebo?
options: Nee, hy stem nie saam nie
questions.memo: Sipho sê 'Ja' en gee 'n rede — hy stem saam.
questions.audio: Lebo: Ek dink ons moet die ou speelpark herstel. Sipho: Ja, dan het die kinders 'n veilige plek om te speel.

questions.question: Wat is die gas se hoofpunt?

questions.expected: Lees en gereelde oefening het haar 'n skrywer gemaak

questions.audio: Onderhoudvoerder: Hoe het jy 'n skrywer geword? Gas: Ek het van kleins af baie gelees en elke dag geskryf, al was dit moeilik.

questions.question: Wat het die gas elke dag gedoen?
questions.audio: Gas: Ek het van kleins af baie gelees en elke dag geskryf.

questions.question: Wat is die kernpunt van die onderhoud?
questions.memo: Die gas beklemtoon samewerking en 'n gedeelde doel.
questions.audio: Onderhoudvoerder: Wat maak 'n goeie span? Gas: 'n Goeie span werk saam, luister na mekaar en deel een doel.

questions.question: Watter drie dinge noem die gas oor 'n goeie span?
questions.memo: Die gas noem saamwerk, luister en 'n gedeelde doel.
questions.audio: Gas: 'n Goeie span werk saam, luister na mekaar en deel een doel.

questions.question: Wat is die hoofpunt van die gesprek?
questions.memo: Die gesprek gaan oor water spaar tydens die droogte.
questions.audio: Ma: Onthou om water te spaar tydens die droogte. Kind: Goed, ek sal die kraan toemaak terwyl ek tande borsel.

questions.question: Hoe gaan die kind water spaar?
questions.memo: Die kind sal die kraan toemaak terwyl hy tande borsel.
questions.audio: Kind: Ek sal die kraan toemaak terwyl ek tande borsel.

questions.question: Wat is die gas se hoofpunt?
questions.memo: Die gas lys verskeie voordele van lees.
questions.audio: Onderhoudvoerder: Hoekom is lees belangrik? Gas: Lees brei jou woordeskat uit, voer jou verbeelding en help jou beter skryf.

questions.question: Watter voordeel van lees word genoem?
questions.audio: Gas: Lees brei jou woordeskat uit en voer jou verbeelding.

questions.question: Wat is die kernpunt?
options: Hulle gaan harder op verdediging oefen
questions.expected: Hulle gaan harder op verdediging oefen
questions.memo: Die afrigter beplan om meer op verdediging te fokus.
questions.audio: Afrigter: Ons het verloor, maar ons het hard probeer. Volgende keer oefen ons meer op verdediging.

questions.question: Wat gaan die span volgende keer beter oefen?
questions.audio: Afrigter: Volgende keer oefen ons meer op verdediging.

questions.question: Wat is die gas se hoofboodskap?
options: Werk hard en leer uit foute
questions.expected: Werk hard en leer uit foute
questions.memo: Die gas se raad: werk hard, wees vriendelik, vrees nie foute nie.
questions.audio: Onderhoudvoerder: Wat is jou raad vir jong mense? Gas: Werk hard, wees vriendelik en moenie bang wees om foute te maak nie.

questions.question: Wat sê die gas oor foute?
questions.memo: Die gas sê 'n mens moenie foute vrees nie.
questions.audio: Gas: Moenie bang wees om foute te maak nie.

questions.expected: Die sportdag is uitgestel na Vrydag

questions.audio: Aandag, leerders. Die sportdag is na Vrydag verskuif weens die reën. Bring asseblief jou hoed en water.

questions.question: Wat moet leerders saambring?
questions.memo: Die aankondiging sê bring 'n hoed en water.
questions.audio: Bring asseblief jou hoed en water.

AF.G8.LUI.02.title: Opsomming en aantekeninge
AF.G8.LUI.02.description: Kies die punte wat jy sou neerskryf wanneer jy 'n luisterteks opsom.
AF.G8.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: 'n Goeie opsomming hou net die belangrikste punte en laat voorbeelde en herhaling uit. Skryf kort, in jou eie woorde.

questions.question: Watter punt sou jy NEERSKRYF in 'n opsomming?
options: Bye bestuif plante sodat ons kos het
questions.expected: Bye bestuif plante sodat ons kos het
questions.memo: Die hoofpunt — bestuiwing vir kos — hoort in 'n opsomming.
questions.audio: Bye is baie belangrik. Hulle bestuif blomme en gewasse sodat ons kos kan kry. Sonder bye sou baie plante nie vrugte dra nie.

questions.question: Watter detail sou jy WEGLAAT uit 'n opsomming?
options: Sonder hulle dra plante nie vrugte nie
questions.memo: Die kleur is 'n klein besonderheid, nie 'n hoofpunt nie.
questions.audio: Bye bestuif blomme. Hulle is geel en swart. Sonder hulle sou plante nie vrugte dra nie.

questions.question: Wat is die beste kort opsomming?

questions.expected: Resiklering verminder vullis en spaar hulpbronne
